Layer.InitCommand:
%melody(function(self) if self:getaux()==1 then return end; self:aux(1); -- initcommand bs
local h = {}
local IS_OITG = config.minimum_build == 'OpenITG'
-- XXX: not sure if i should make this a function so that we can apply duplicated input -- mid-file but i think just one call to this is enough local IS_DUPLICATED = PREFSMAN:GetPreference('InputDuplication')
local function isPlayerActive(pn) return GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(pn-1) and GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(pn-1) end local function getAlternatePlayer(pn) return pn == 1 and 2 or 1 end
-- XXX: on 2p setup, this should be false -- otherwise, this is the active player number h.SINGLEPLAYER = false if isPlayerActive(1) and not isPlayerActive(2) then h.SINGLEPLAYER = 1 elseif not isPlayerActive(1) and isPlayerActive(2) then h.SINGLEPLAYER = 2 end
-- globals h.PLAYER_LEFT = 1 h.PLAYER_DOWN = 2 h.PLAYER_UP = 3 h.PLAYER_RIGHT = 4
h.ACTION_1 = 1 h.ACTION_2 = 2 h.ACTION_3 = 3 h.ACTION_4 = 4 h.ACTION_5 = 5 h.ACTION_6 = 6 h.ACTION_7 = 7 h.ACTION_8 = 8
h.TYPE_STEP = 0 -- runs once h.TYPE_PRESS = 1 -- runs continuously h.TYPE_LIFT = 2 -- runs once
h.MODE_PLAYER = 0 h.MODE_ACTION = 1 h.MODE_GLOBAL = 2
-- raw data local raw = {} raw.global = {} raw.input = {} raw.action = {} raw.hinput = {} -- held raw.haction = {} -- held
for pn=1,2 do raw.global[pn] = false
raw.input[pn] = {} raw.hinput[pn] = {} for col=1,4 do raw.input[pn][col] = false; raw.hinput[pn][col] = false; end
raw.action[pn] = {} raw.haction[pn] = {} for act=1,7 do raw.action[pn][act] = false; raw.haction[pn][act] = false; end end
function h:GetRawInput(listenType, pn, col) if listenType == h.MODE_PLAYER then local i = raw.input[ pn ] return (col and i[col] or i) end
if listenType == h.MODE_ACTION then local i = raw.action[ pn ] return (col and i[col] or i) end
return nil end
-- funcs local disabled = false function h:Disable(v) disabled = (v == true) end
-- hooks local hooks = {} hooks[ h.MODE_PLAYER ] = { [ h.TYPE_STEP ] = {}, [ h.TYPE_PRESS ] = {}, [ h.TYPE_LIFT ] = {}, } hooks[ h.MODE_ACTION ] = { [ h.TYPE_STEP ] = {}, [ h.TYPE_PRESS ] = {}, [ h.TYPE_LIFT ] = {}, } hooks[ h.MODE_GLOBAL ] = {}
function h:OnInput(listenType, listenId, func) hooks[ self.MODE_PLAYER ][ listenType ][ listenId ] = func return function() hooks[ self.MODE_PLAYER ][ listenType ][ listenId ] = nil end end function h:OnAction(listenType, listenId, func) hooks[ self.MODE_ACTION ][ listenType ][ listenId ] = func return function() hooks[ self.MODE_ACTION ][ listenType ][ listenId ] = nil end end function h:OnGlobal(listenId, func) hooks[ self.MODE_GLOBAL ][ listenId ] = func return function() hooks[ self.MODE_GLOBAL ][ listenId ] = nil end end
-- updates local function handleGlobalInput(pn) if not raw.global[pn] then return end
for _, func in pairs( hooks[ h.MODE_GLOBAL ] ) do func( pn ) if IS_DUPLICATED then func( getAlternatePlayer(pn) ) end end
raw.global[pn] = false end
local function broadcastInput(listenMode, listenType, col, pn) for _, func in pairs( hooks[ listenMode ][ listenType ] ) do func( col, pn ) if IS_DUPLICATED then func( col, getAlternatePlayer(pn) ) end end end
local function handleColumnInput(pn) local _i = raw.input[pn] local _hi = raw.hinput[pn]
for col=1,4 do if _i[col] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_PLAYER, h.TYPE_PRESS, col, pn )
if not _hi[col] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_PLAYER, h.TYPE_STEP, col, pn ) _hi[col] = true end else if _hi[col] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_PLAYER, h.TYPE_LIFT, col, pn ) _hi[col] = false end end end end local function handleActionInput(pn) local _a = raw.action[pn] local _ha = raw.haction[pn]
for act=1,8 do if _a[act] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_ACTION, h.TYPE_PRESS, act, pn )
if not _ha[act] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_ACTION, h.TYPE_STEP, act, pn ) _ha[act] = true end else if _ha[act] then broadcastInput( h.MODE_ACTION, h.TYPE_LIFT, act, pn ) _ha[act] = false end end end end update_hooks{'input handler', function() if disabled then return end
for pn=1,2 do handleGlobalInput(pn)
if not IS_OITG then handleColumnInput(pn) handleActionInput(pn) end end end}
-- messagecommand local dir = {'Left','Down','Up','Right'} for pn=1,2 do local pn = pn
self:addcommand('StepP'..pn..'Message',function() raw.global[pn] = true end)
if not IS_OITG then for col=1,4 do local col = col self:addcommand('StepP'..pn..dir[col]..'PressMessage',function() raw.input[pn][col] = true; end) self:addcommand('StepP'..pn..dir[col]..'LiftMessage',function() raw.input[pn][col] = false; end) end for act=1,8 do local act = act self:addcommand('StepP'..pn..'Action'..act..'PressMessage',function() raw.action[pn][act] = true; end) self:addcommand('StepP'..pn..'Action'..act..'LiftMessage',function() raw.action[pn][act] = false; end) end end end
-- shorthand IH = h end)
